title: Chevening Fully Funded Master's Scholarship
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from around the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in the UK across any field.

title: STEP Intern - Computer Science 2025
eligibility: First or second-year undergraduate students majoring in Computer Science or related fields
qualification: Enrolled in undergraduate Bachelor's degree program
description: Student Training in Engineering Program (STEP) is a 12-week developmental internship providing hands-on software engineering project experience.

title: Junior Remote Full Stack Engineer
eligibility: Strong fundamentals in Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript; open globally
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS or equivalent practical experience
description: Develop high-impact enterprise dashboard web applications, public sites, and cloud portals completely remotely.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with under 2 years of product management experience
description: A rotational product leadership program giving early-career talent ownership of high-impact products across different product groups.

title: Imagine Cup Global Student Competition
eligibility: Students aged 18+ enrolled in high school or university worldwide
description: Global student technology competition inviting participants to build innovative AI solutions addressing real-world societal problems.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to all, no prior programming experience required
description: An introductory course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using languages such as C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
